messages:
lina: ZetaCorp asks if credits from 3 parallel POCs can be stacked and then consolidated into one commit if they convert within 90 days.
marco: Possible only if POCs roll up to the same billing entity. Separate legal entities = separate commits.
kate: Deal Desk: we can do consolidated commit but require clear SOW mapping and a stacking cap (default 2). Exceptions via Deal Desk approval.
sam: Technical: different models/instance types => per-token costs differ. Quote needs model multipliers or per-POC SKUs.
jess: RevOps prefers metered+credited so we keep telemetry. If customer insists on invisible metering, ops complexity increases.
lina: Customer wants "no charge during POC, credits reserved for 90d". Is 90d ok?
kate: 90d OK. Terms to include: credits expire after 90d; non-transferable across billing entities; stacking limit = 2 active POCs per billing entity w/o approval.
marco: Note: shared infra (same project/endpoints) can give KV/cache savings; call that out in quote.
jess: RevOps import CSV format: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,COMMIT_ID.
ops-bot: Use /deal-request with SOW + CSV. Template: https://confluence.redwood/poc-commit-matrix (internal).
kate: Draft SOW snippet to include in request:
```nBILLING_ENTITY=ZetaCorp-Holdings
POC_TAG=ZETA-POC-2026-03
POC_WINDOW=2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30
POC_CREDIT=100% of usage for POC window up to $30,000 per POC
CONSOLIDATED_COMMIT=Apply up to $60,000/mo for 12 months if signed within 90d
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=90d
STACKING_LIMIT=2 active POCs per billing entity without Deal Desk approval
``
legal-bot: Legal note: credits are timeboxed and applied to future invoices; no refunds for committed fees; include audit/validation clause.
lina: I'll attach CSV and traffic estimates to deal-request and wait for legal sign-off. Thanks.
